settings.title: Shop All Styles & Colors
settings.body: One patented grip system, two builds. Closed Sole wraps your entire foot. Open Sole frees your heel for a barefoot feel. Same 360° grip, same durability, same $74. Choose the one that fits your practice.
settings.closed_desc: Full coverage including heel — more protection everywhere. 360° grip across the entire underfoot. Ideal for reformer footwork, barre, Lagree, and any studio discipline where full-foot lockdown matters.
settings.open_desc: Open heel with a mid-foot vent — your heel contacts the surface directly for a grounded, barefoot-like feel with extra airflow. Same 360° grip where it matters most. Ideal for mat work, yoga, and heated studios.
